# serverroom_port_alert (Resource)

Alert when a dedicated server's port stays above a share of its sold speed. Destroying it turns the alert off.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Alert when the server's port stays above 90% of its speed for 15 minutes.
resource "serverroom_port_alert" "web" {
  account_id = 246447
  threshold  = 90
  sustain    = 15
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (Number)

### Optional

- `direction` (String) either (default), inbound or outbound.
- `sustain` (Number) Minutes, 10-240 (default 15).
- `threshold` (Number) Percent of the port speed, 50-100 (default 90).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `port_speed_mbps` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import serverroom_port_alert.web 246447
```
